title: Modules courbes elliptiques en caractéristiques ≠2 : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This page is part of a systematic census of the subgroups of G = S_I, the symmetric group of a 4-element set I. On the previous page, I is the set of points of order 2 or a level structure in the elliptic-modular context. That page handled the 2-subgroups (part A). This page handles part B, the subgroups whose order is a multiple of 3, and then totals everything.

g) Order 3: the four Sylow 3-subgroups. They are indexed by I, since each fixes one point of I. One conjugacy class.

h) Order 6: there is no element of order 6 in S4, so these are non-cyclic and isomorphic to D_3 ≅ S_3. They are the stabilizers of points of I, which equal the normalizers of the Sylow 3-subgroups. Four of them, one class.

i) Order 12: a unique subgroup of index 2, because the abelianization of G is Z/2. It is the alternating group A_I. One class.

Tally:
- 19 nontrivial 2-subgroups in 6 conjugacy classes. These are 3+6 of order 2, then 3 cyclic C4 + the normal V + 3 non-normal Klein groups of order 4, then 3 Sylow subgroups of order 8.
- 9 proper subgroups of order divisible by 3, in 3 classes.
- Total: 28 nontrivial proper subgroups in 9 classes, or 30 subgroups in 11 classes including {e} and G.

These classes correspond to the isomorphism classes of transitive G-sets (homogeneous spaces G/H). Grothendieck notes that one should arrange them in the lattice or diagram of inclusions, equivalently the diagram of morphisms of homogeneous spaces.

Purpose: the next page (§4, 'Relations avec les cartes orientées') uses specific homogeneous spaces of S4, namely Circ(I) with stabilizer Z/4 and P_2(I) with stabilizer Klein. Each maps 2:1 onto J = V* ≅ P_{2,2}(I). He interprets these combinatorial maps as data of maps (dessins) on the sphere. This links to the S4 ≅ PGL_2(F_3) or anharmonic-group structure underlying level-2 moduli of elliptic curves.
errors: No mathematical errors. S4 indeed has 30 subgroups in 11 conjugacy classes, and all the counts (19/6, 9/3, 28/9, 30/11) check out.
Minor wording: 'd'ordre multiple de 3, donc d'ordre 3, 6 ou 12' tacitly excludes 24 (G itself), which he corrects later with '≠ G'.

ideas.what: Complete enumeration of the subgroups of S4 by order and conjugacy class: 30 subgroups, 11 classes.
ideas.modern_name: Subgroup lattice of S4 / table of marks / Burnside ring of S4

ideas.what: Conjugacy classes of subgroups correspond to isomorphism classes of homogeneous G-spaces, and inclusions correspond to G-maps; he suggests drawing the diagram of morphisms of homogeneous spaces.
ideas.modern_name: Orbit category / Galois correspondence for G-sets
ideas.where_published: SGA1 (Galois categories) contains the general principle

ideas.what: Order-6 subgroups are the point stabilizers, which are the normalizers of the Sylow 3-subgroups; the unique index-2 subgroup comes from G_ab = Z/2.

deep.surprise_reason: This is a routine, correct textbook enumeration of the subgroups of S4. Grothendieck does it as preparation for interpreting S4-homogeneous spaces as combinatorial maps (dessins) on the next page. Nothing on this page is new.
transcription_corrections: Last paragraph: the image reads roughly 'il faudrait les ranger dans un diagramme ordonné [par/d'] inclusions, ou diagr. de morphismes d'espaces homogènes' — essentially as transcribed.
The abelianization in i) may be written 'G_ab ≃ {±1}' rather than 'Z/2' (same meaning).
The insertion above '19 sous-groupes' is uncertain; 'ci-dessus' is plausible but unconfirmed.
